summary.text: The bright upper air, born when Nyx joined with Erebus — light emerging from the union of Night and Darkness.
In Hyginus, Aether is not the child of Night and Erebus but their sibling, born with them from Chaos and Mist.

story.text: From Chaos came Erebus and black Night; Night then conceived by Erebus and bore Aether and Day. Hesiod makes brightness and daylight the first children of the two primeval darknesses.
Hyginus rearranges the first family. Night, Day, Erebus and Aether all arise together from Chaos and Caligo, or Mist; Aether and Day then become parents of Earth, Heaven and Sea.
